text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No 2 soybean basis November futures on CBOT. The company bought the soybeans from Marubeni Corp for shipment in early November from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was set for the port city of Inchon.

VEGOIL SALE - Morocco purchased 43,500 tonnes of vegetable oil at $541 to $543 per tonne C&F for delivery in December-February, the Casablanca-based Bureau des Approvisionnements en Huile Alimentaire said. A first lot of 12,000 tonnes was purchased at $541 per tonne C&F for arrival January 1-15, 1997. A second lot of 13,500 tonnes was bought at $541 per tonne C&F for delivery by end January 1997. A third lot of 18,000 tonnes was purchased at $543 per tonne C&F for delivery in first half of February 1997.

COTTONSEED MEAL TENDER - South Korean feed mill companies will invite tenders for 5,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal by 0600 GMT on Tuesday, traders said. The origin would be set based on the seller's option for delivery on December 30.

WHEAT AND BARLEY TENDER - The Japanese Food Agency will tender Tuesday night for a total of 80,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, 40,000 tonnes Canadian wheat and 17,000 tonnes Australian prime hard wheat, U.S.-based Japanese export firms said.
The U.S. wheat would include 40,000 tonnes western white wheat, 20,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat and 20,000 tonnes hard red winter wheat, 13 percent protein content.
WHEAT AND BARLEY TENDER cont'd - The Canadian wheat would include 20,000 tonnes spring wheat, 5,000 tonnes western red spring and 15,000 durum.

Japan will also seek 3,000 tonnes Canadian western six-row barley, 17,000 tonnes Canadian feed barley and 20,000 tonnes Australian feed barley. Shipment for all commodities was slated for December 1-January 10.

WHEAT TENDER - The CCC said it is retendering for up to 35,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 or better hard red winter, soft white or soft red winter wheat for donation to Eritrea. Shipment was slated for Oct 30-Nov 25. Offers must be due by October 15.

WHEAT TENDERS cont'd - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a company spokesman said. An international call for prices setting October 29 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on October 30 for December shipment.

GECPT also said it offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale. An international call for prices setting October 15 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on October 16. The amount would be ready for November shipment.
